title: Two Little Monkeys & The Golden Swing: Taking Turns!

lines.text: Pip and Pop the monkey twins raced into the playground to grab the brand new tire swing!
lines.caps: Pip and Pop the monkey twins raced into the *PLAYGROUND | to grab the brand new tire *SWING!

lines.text: I got here first! yelled Pip. No, I grabbed the rope first! shouted Pop!
lines.caps: I got here *FIRST! | yelled Pip. No, I grabbed the rope *FIRST! | shouted *POP!

lines.text: They pulled and yanked on opposite sides, twisting the rope into an angry tangle!
lines.caps: They pulled and yanked on opposite *SIDES, | twisting the rope into an angry *TANGLE!

lines.text: Ten minutes passed, both monkeys were sweaty and red-faced, and nobody was swinging!
lines.caps: Ten minutes passed, both monkeys were *SWEATY | and red-faced, and nobody was *SWINGING!

lines.text: Mama Monkey walked over with a fun little sand-timer shaped like a smiling banana!
lines.caps: Mama Monkey walked over with a fun little *SAND-TIMER | shaped like a smiling *BANANA!

lines.text: Pip gets three minutes to soar to the clouds, then Pop takes the pilot seat!
lines.caps: Pip gets three minutes to soar to the *CLOUDS, | then Pop takes the pilot *SEAT!

lines.text: Pip counted his swings joyfully, and when the timer chimed, handed the swing to Pop!
lines.caps: Pip counted his swings joyfully, and when the timer *CHIMED, | handed the swing to *POP!

lines.text: Taking turns turns stubborn arguments into double the laughter and twice the fun!
lines.caps: Taking turns turns stubborn arguments into *DOUBLE | the laughter and twice the *FUN!

lines.text: Play nicely together and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
